posthoc_qualified_metrics.depth_qualified_position_method: round(inStrain scaffold_info length * breadth_minCov) at min_cov=5 (instrain_1.9.1_verified_default_min_cov_5_from_argumentParser); inferred depth-qualified positions (>=min_cov) only — full variant callable status also requires base quality, read pair ANI, and allele frequency/FDR filters

raw_cumulative_variant_reconciliation.source_semantics: calc_snps counts last cumulative record per position at mm<=threshold, without cryptic filter. SNVprofile.get_nonredundant_snv_table filters cryptic==False BEFORE sorting mm and keeping last per scaffold+position.

posthoc_qualified_metrics.read_covered_position_method: round(inStrain scaffold_info length * breadth); positions with >=1 mapped read
posthoc_qualified_metrics.variant_count_reconciliation_semantics: scaffold_info.tsv SNV_count/SNS_count/divergent_site_count (calc_snps in inStrain/profile/snv_utilities.py:249-272) count the last cumulative_snv_table record per position at mm<=max_mm WITHOUT filtering cryptic==True sites (where divergent_site_count = SNV_count + SNS_count + zero_allele_divergent_site_count); exported <prefix>_SNVs.tsv (SNVprofile.get_nonredundant_snv_table in inStrain/SNVprofile.py:495-510) filters cryptic==False BEFORE sorting mm and keeping last per (scaffold, position). Both counts are reproducible with distinct meanings: summary divergent_site_count = exported non-cryptic rows + excluded cryptic positions; zero exported variants does not imply zero summary sites when cryptic sites are present.
posthoc_qualified_metrics.variant_interpretation: sequence polymorphism (SNV_count) and fixed consensus substitutions (SNS_count) only; inferred depth-qualified positions (round(length * breadth_minCov) at >=min_cov) are necessary but not sufficient for full variant callability (which also requires base quality, read pair ANI, and allele frequency/FDR filters); variants are never evidence of recombination

results.variant_interpretation: sequence polymorphism only; variants are not evidence of recombination
